author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಇಳೆಯೊಳಗೆ ಬೀಜದಲಿ ಶಕ್ತಿ ತುಂಬುವರಾರು
ಎಳನೀರ ತೆಂಗೊಳಗೆ ತುರುಕಿದವನಾರು
ಗಳಿಗೆಯಲುತ್ಪತ್ತಿ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಲಯವ ಮಾಡುವವ
ತಳೆದಿಹನು ನಿಸ್ಪೃಹತೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Who fills the seed in the earth with power?
who poured the water into the tender coconut?
the one who creates, sustains and dissolves in a moment
has taken on perfect detachment, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Who puts life into a seed, or water into a coconut? The power that creates, sustains and dissolves everything does so without any wish for reward. Its detachment is a lesson to us.
